items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] After that band broke up with Paul Jones and Kate Johnson and all of them... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember who was there.

ctx.x: No, no this was way later. This was in between Claude Hopkins and Fats.
OH YEAH. RIGHT AROUND THE TIME FLETCHER WAS REORGANIZING. AFTER THAT BAND BROKE UP WITH PAUL JONES, JOHNSON AND OTHERS, THE BAND HAD DAN WEBSTER AND JOE THOMAS, RED ALLEN WAS IN THE BAND WITH YOU.
I don't think so. I don't remember who was in the band.
